core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gilani corresponds to the Arabic form جيلاني (Arabic nisba جيلاني (Jīlānī) 'of Gilan'). Its core sense is of gilan (a region in iran). Gilani is the Arabic nisba جيلاني (Jīlānī) 'of Gilan' — the Caspian province of Iran (Persian گیلان). It is best known through the Sufi saint ʿAbd al-Qādir al-Jīlānī. The source gloss 'from the garden' is a folk etymology (reading gol 'flower' into the place-name); the correct relational sense is 'of Gilan'.
